name: upstairs hall
description: a long, dim hallway on the second floor. the carpet is threadbare and stained, the wallpaper peeling in long strips. a portrait of augustus blackwood in his prime hangs at the far end, his painted eyes seeming to follow you. a cold draft seeps from under one of the doors. the floorboards creak in a pattern that sounds almost like footsteps behind you — but when you stop, they stop too.

items.name: portrait_hall
items.description: a painting of augustus blackwood in his prime. his cold, calculating eyes follow you around the room. the nameplate reads: 'augustus blackwood, 1835-1891, patriarch of blackwood manor.' there's a crack in the canvas — deliberate, not from age.

items.name: candle_holder
items.description: a brass wall sconce with a half-melted candle. the wax has dripped down in frozen rivulets. the candle was extinguished recently — the wick is still slightly warm.

items.name: moldy_sandwich
items.description: a forgotten sandwich on a small table. it's green and fuzzy with age. definitely do not eat this.

items.name: ghostly_figure
items.description: at the far end of the hall, near the portrait, you catch a glimpse of something in your peripheral vision. a young girl in a white nightgown, standing perfectly still. when you turn to look directly, she's gone.

items.name: white_feather
items.description: a single white feather, impossibly clean and fresh in this dusty old mansion. it's warm to the touch.

exits.description: a pull-down ladder in the ceiling. cold air and darkness descend from above.
a door with a frosted glass panel. the light behind it flickers, though there's no electricity.
a grand staircase leading up into impenetrable darkness. the steps creak under the slightest weight.
a simple wooden door, standing ajar. darkness within.
another door, slightly ajar. a child's voice seems to whisper from within, then falls silent when you focus on it.
a large oak door with a polished brass knob — polished recently, as it gleams.
a small door with a faded teddy bear painting, its colors long since bled to ghosts of themselves.
